items.content:
Read back through this whole thing tonight, which I don't recommend.

What I notice: I made the camera decision in about six weeks and I have
been not-making the other one for fourteen years. Same person. I don't
think that's hypocrisy exactly. I think some decisions have a shape you
can hold and some don't.

Also I mention Sid more than I realised.

summary: Rereading the year, she contrasts the camera choice with the father one
title: A year of this
